responsibility: Defines the user-visible and internal target options for the Arm port and the target variables they control. It declares options such as -mabi, -mcpu, -march, -mfpu, -mfloat-abi, branch-protection, endianness, Thumb mode, TLS, stack-protector guard selection, and many tuning or workaround flags, along with the generated target state variables and enums consumed by backend option-processing code.
same_name_distinction: Defines the generated option-table entries and target variables for Arm command-line flags, including branch-protection state variables from aarch-common.h, rather than backend implementation code in arm.cc, target macros in arm.h, or instruction patterns in arm.md.
